name: Wikidata SPARQL Query Service
rate_limits: 60 second query timeout. No explicit request rate limit documented, but fair use expected. Concurrent connection limits may apply.
notes: 100M+ items in the knowledge graph. CC0 licensed. Supports SPARQL 1.1 queries. Returns JSON (with format=json param) or XML by default. Also supports CSV/TSV output. Federated queries can join with external SPARQL endpoints. Separate scholarly article endpoint at query-scholarly.wikidata.org. REST API also available at wikidata.org/w/rest.php/. Interactive query builder at query.wikidata.org. GraphQL API also available.
